posts.meta_description:
4,430 likes, 43 comments - athleanx on October 13, 2026: "Don’t let the hardest part of the exercise prevent you from doing the exercise entirely. Bands are great for making resistance curves more favorable. Here, we know getting out of the hole on the dip is the most difficult part. It’s also the zone of greatest pec and front delt stretch so it shouldn’t necessarily be avoided - just accommodated. Using the bands as shown here will give you the assist at the bottom and remove the help at the top where you’re stronger. Even if you’re strong enough for weighted dips you can always have these on the ready for a drop set once you’ve fatigued with the weights - to keep training to and through failure. 

Remember, movement patterns have value. Specific exercises can be adapted to ensure you don’t miss out on the pattern. It’s how to train smart, train as hard as YOU can right now, and keep pushing ahead! Let the gains begin! #dips #bands #bandexercises #training #athleanx".

posts.meta_description: 4,147 likes, 174 comments - athleanx on September 22, 2026: "The leg press can provide a safer option for developing the quads if knee pain or a weak back is making squats difficult. But please don’t try and make this a great “glute exercise”, because it isn’t. It’s missing some key points that I lay out for you here. If you want great glute development options look for the sprinter Bulgarian split squat or a basic barbell hip thrust. Let the gains begin #gains #glutes #musclebuilding #trainsmarter #athleanx".

posts.meta_description: 3,741 likes, 164 comments - athleanx on September 9, 2026: "I see the function but I don’t prefer the form. Separated out into their individual parts (pull-ups and dips) I have no issues at all. But transition from one to the other seamlessly on a muscle up and my alarm bells go off as my shoulder screams “uncle”. Now some calisthenics masters have learned to minimize this effect at the shoulder by being able to use their lats to “lever” their body and take away some of the IR. But that requires a level of strength that many who attempt the movement just haven’t spent the time building up. For me, I’d do the components but skip the all-in-one version! #muscles #muscleups #calisthenics #trainsmart #athleanx".

posts.meta_description: 5,967 likes, 58 comments - athleanx on August 5, 2026: "Don’t forget the “other” glute muscle! Everyone wants to develop bigger, stronger glutes but they overlook the “medius” in an over enthusiasm for the “maximus”. Yeah I get it. Instagram rewards those chasing the glute max gains but trust me…the rest of us, the ones suffering from chronic low back pain and seem to have no particular cause that we can pinpoint for the issue? That’s who needs to wake up to the importance of the glute medius and ultimately wake up a muscle that lies far too dormant,  under activated and weak. Try this simple hip bump exercise and you’ll target it without needing elaborate equipment, space or setup! Let the gains begin and let me know how it works for you! #glutemedius #glutes #notpeaches #gym #athleanx".
